title: Lead and Asbestos Cutoffs and Fees by Water Damage Mitigation Tier
content:
The Water Damage Mitigation regulated materials schedule fixes, for each tier, the year-built cutoffs and the interior painted-surface threshold that decide when lead-safe practices and asbestos sampling apply, and the per-job fees for each.

| Tier | Lead-safe setup (per job) | RRP year-built cutoff | RRP interior threshold (sq ft per room) | Asbestos sampling (per job) | Asbestos sampling year cutoff |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Clean Water Mitigation - Standard Loss | $345.00 | 1978 | 6 | $425.00 | 1981 |
| Clean Water Mitigation - Large Loss | $395.00 | 1978 | 6 | $595.00 | 1981 |
| Gray Water Mitigation - Standard Loss | $345.00 | 1978 | 6 | $425.00 | 1981 |
| Gray Water Mitigation - Large Loss | $395.00 | 1978 | 6 | $595.00 | 1981 |
| Black Water Mitigation - Standard Loss | $345.00 | 1978 | 6 | $425.00 | 1981 |
| Black Water Mitigation - Large Loss | $395.00 | 1978 | 6 | $595.00 | 1981 |

## Schedule definitions
- **Lead-safe setup**: Lead-safe work practice setup (EPA RRP containment, cleaning verification) per job, USD.
- **RRP year-built cutoff**: Housing built before this year triggers lead-safe practices when painted surfaces are disturbed (EPA RRP pre-1978 housing), year.
- **RRP interior threshold**: Interior painted surface disturbed per room above which lead-safe practices apply (EPA RRP minor-repair threshold), square feet.
- **Asbestos sampling**: Pre-demolition asbestos sampling of drywall, joint compound and texture (collection plus lab), per job, USD.
- **Asbestos sampling year cutoff**: Buildings built before this year are sampled for asbestos before any flood cut or tear-out (company policy), year.

## Reading the cutoffs
| Year built | Before the RRP cutoff of 1978 | Before the asbestos cutoff of 1981 |
|---|---|---|
| 1977 | yes | yes |
| 1978 | no | yes |
| 1980 | no | yes |
| 1981 | no | no |

The cutoffs and the threshold are identical on all six tiers; only the two fees differ, by size of loss.
